title: Four-body additivity: A-B-C-A square, side 5, T = 2 (charge-mass pair law)
pitch: Tests whether the P-0036 charge-mass pair law (A q=1 m=1, B q=0.5 m=0.72, C q=-0.5 m=0.42, P-0029 K table) adds pairwise for four bodies. Four particles at the corners of a side-5 square: A, B, C, A. Pairwise-sum prediction is computed from the filed setup (RK4 h=1e-3, specular walls). Min pair distance over T=2 is 3.6, so no contact. A 20 percent K error moves the trajectories by about 0.05 absolute RMS, so the test is a scale fit at sigma 0.05, not a judged-bar test. Pass if the fitted scale is within 0.05 of 1.
